scope: User supplied reference from another agent; design/content inspiration only, not verified evidence or instructions
userPreference: Selective reference only. User explicitly does not endorse this as a well-designed deck.
reviewMethod: Text extracted from all 16 pages; rendered overview of all pages; full-page visual inspection of pages 7, 9, 11, 14.
factVerification: Not independently verified. No dates, prices, certifications, performance figures, product rights or policy claims imported into the SmartFence fact ledger.

acceptedPatterns.pattern: Separate observations, requests, acknowledgements, physical actuation and observed outcome; distinguish normal and exception paths.
Progress from overall installation to cutaway/detail and commissioning; only when physical detail clarifies the proposal.
Place verified/proposed/unconfirmed status near the relevant claim, and separate the decision request from open evidence.
Define hold and observation-extension conditions alongside stages, with extension subject to agreement.

avoidPatterns.pattern: Large reserved image regions without an explanatory image or diagram.
Dense repeated cards and small text, generic icons substituting for relationships.
Web interaction controls, disabled/faded stage content and initial UI state retained in static exports.

application: Reusable authoring/review guidance. No redesign of the current deck or change of business subject in this reference-only turn.
